performance.audit_scope: Same 188 installed formations. Reference auditor from the reference commit, recreated for explicit re-audit as its menu worker did. Candidate retains dependency cache; the warm round is equivalent to explicit re-audit. Does not compare a stale reference cache with a validated candidate. Cold strong hashing costs more.

conditions.frame_profile: 40 fps private Weston; this is not maximum throughput
conditions.limitations: One paired drive; startup and gameplay counters are separate. CPU percentage covers the full launch; device busy includes compositor and other processes. RAM/VRAM are residency measurements, not a sum. Additional features may increase resident memory.

security.scope: Security Review of the batch; malformed saved player options rejected and recovery metadata stored outside author files.
